mapper.select: select * from user_search_history where user_id = #{userId} and is_deleted = 0 order by create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into user_search_history (user_id, keyword, search_type, create_time) values (#{po.userId}, #{po.keyword},#{po.searchType}, #{po.createTime})
mapper.select: select ui.user_id as user_id, ui.user_name as user_name, ui.image as image, ui.introduction as introduction, IFNULL(post_stats.content_count, 0) as contentCount, IFNULL(browse_stats.view_count, 0) as viewCount, IFNULL(like_stats.liked_count, 0) as likedCount from user_info ui left join ( -- 统计用户文章总数 select author_id, count(*) as content_count from posts where status = 2 group by author_id ) post_stats on ui.user_id = post_stats.author_id left join ( -- 统计用户文章总浏览量 select p.author_id, count(b.id) as view_count from posts p left join browse b on p.id = b.post_id and b.type = 0 where p.status = 2 group by p.author_id ) browse_stats on ui.user_id = browse_stats.author_id left join ( -- 统计用户文章总被点赞数 select p.author_id, count(l.id) as liked_count from posts p left join likes l on p.id = l.target_id and l.type = 0 and l.status = 0 where p.status = 2 group by p.author_id ) like_stats on ui.user_id = like_stats.author_id where ( ui.user_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ui.introduction like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) and ui.user_id is not null order by post_stats.content_count desc, browse_stats.view_count desc, ui.user_id desc
mapper.update: update user_search_history set is_deleted = 1 where user_id = #{userId}
